text: DSH WeChat Mini Game 是面向 DSH Web 的微信小游戏开发插件。它把小游戏开发 skill、预览状态接口和客户端启动器接入 DSH，并通过 MCP 桥连接小游戏助手。用户可启动或热重载预览、查看运行日志和截图、扫码进行真机体验，并上传发布版本；运行中的预览可在 DSH 右侧内置浏览器打开。适合在 DSH 中迭代微信小游戏的开发者。需要 Node.js 与 npx；真机预览和发布需配置微信 AppID 与上传私钥。

DSH WeChat Mini Game adds game previews and tools to DSH Web. Its MCP bridge supports preview, logs, screenshots, phone testing, and publishing; a header button opens the game in the built-in sidebar. Requires Node.js and npx; phone testing and publishing need a WeChat AppID and upload private key.

帮我看小游戏运行日志和截图，定位白屏或报错
我想用手机扫码体验当前的微信小游戏
怎么从 DSH 把小游戏版本上传到微信平台？
I want to preview and debug a WeChat Mini Game from DSH Web.
**DSH WeChat Mini Game** 的功能「预览与热重载」：通过小游戏助手的 MCP 工具启动或热重载项目预览；状态轮询发现游戏已服务后，会在 DSH 内置右侧浏览器打开预览。
**DSH WeChat Mini Game** 的功能「查看日志与截图」：调用助手工具读取小游戏控制台日志和错误，并捕获当前画面或连续截图，便于检查运行结果。
**DSH WeChat Mini Game** 的功能「真机体验与发布」：使用助手工具生成真机预览二维码，并将指定版本上传到微信平台；这些操作通过 MCP 桥接提供。
DSH WeChat Mini Game 通过 npx 获取小游戏助手 MCP 包；真机预览和发布需微信 AppID 与上传私钥。 (见 cordis.patch.yml:35-44；README.md:42-43)

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · @trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Preview, develop, and debug (through logs and screenshots) WeChat Mini Games inside the dsh Web GUI. The preview runs in dsh's built-in browser tab; the plugin adds no window of its own. Modelled on the official [WeChat Mini Game Helper](https://gamemp.weixin.qq.com/doc/minigame-helper/guide/vscode-plugin.html).

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · What it gives you：| Surface | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Browser preview** | The mini game opens in dsh's built-in browser tab in the right sidebar, which supplies history, reload, and the address bar. The helper's own preview page supplies the ⚙️ configuration and QR dialogs. Both the preview and the credentials are managed by the official mini game helper service; this plugin neither stores nor uploads anything. |
| **`weixin-minigame-helper` skill** | Guidance for the MCP tools and this plugin, and for the game development workflow. |
| **MCP bridge** | Connects dsh to the mini game helper service. |

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · From your side：| You want to | Example prompt |
| --- | --- |
| See the game running | "Bring the mini game project in the current workspace up so I can look at it" |
| Fix a crash or a blank screen | "Preview the current workspace mini game and keep fixing until the log is clean" |
| Check what the frame actually renders | "Take a screenshot after that change so I can see it" |
| Try it on a real phone | "Run a real-device test on the current workspace mini game" |
| Ship a version | "Publish the current workspace mini game as 1.0.1, note: score fix" |

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · From the capability side：| Capability | Backing MCP tools |
| --- | --- |
| Start or hot-reload the preview | `run_game` |
| Read console output and errors | `get_logs` |
| Capture the rendered frame, single or burst | `capture_screenshot`, `capture_screenshot_burst`, `stop_screenshot_burst` |
| Real-device QR preview | `real_device_preview` |
| Upload a version to the WeChat platform | `publish` |
| Platform launch workflow — game info, filing, qualification, version submission | `open_onboarding` and the `mp_*` family |

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · Install：- Requires: dsh Web, Node `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0` (the same range dsh itself requires), npx
- Not required: WeChat DevTools (install it if you want to debug code yourself)

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · From npm：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame
```

Then **restart `dsh web`**: the client-module registry caches package metadata for the life of the process, so a newly added row is only discovered at the next boot. After that, edits to `lib/client.js` reload on their own through the always-mounted client HMR chain.

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · From a local checkout (developing this plugin)：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add <absolute path to this plugin>
```

Installing from a **directory** creates a link to the checkout, so a later `pnpm run build` takes effect without reinstalling. The first activation still needs the `dsh web` restart above.

To verify what npm would actually publish, use a tarball instead:

```sh
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./trujaycc-dsh-weixin-minigame-0.1.0.tgz
```

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · The game project itself：- A WeChat Mini Game directory containing `game.js`.
- Real-device preview and publish additionally need a WeChat **AppID** and an **upload private key**, configured through the ⚙️ button in the preview page; see the [official documentation](https://gamemp.weixin.qq.com/doc/minigame-helper/guide/vscode-plugin.html).

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · Skill injection：One skill joins the session catalog — `weixin-minigame-helper`, described as the preview/repair loop for WeChat mini game code. Its body is loaded only when the model calls the `skill` tool; the catalog itself carries the name and description alone, capped by the harness's catalog limit.

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · No other prompt injection：No system-prompt section is registered, so nothing is paid on unrelated turns. The MCP tool schemas come from the upstream service and are registered only after a successful handshake; a bridge that fails to start merely leaves those tools absent and does not affect dsh startup.

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · Interface：A trigger button joins the top-right of the session header (the lamp on its left is green while a project is running, grey when idle, and hollow when the plugin is not mounted). Clicking it opens — or reopens — the preview in dsh's built-in browser tab in the right sidebar; the tab also opens automatically the first time a packaged game is served. dsh's browser supplies back/forward/reload and the address bar, and nothing floats over the conversation.

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · Interface：The bundle patch enables dsh's `ui-sidebar-browser` row, because Web profiles ship it disabled by default; Desktop already has it on, so the override changes nothing there.

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **The upstream MCP server is a third-party dependency.** It is fetched by `npx` at boot, with the version pinned in `cordis.patch.yml` (currently `0.1.35`). Tool names, parameters, and behaviour can change with an upstream release, so run this plugin's tests before bumping that pin.
- **The official mini game helper service leaves files in the game project** (screenshots, and so on). Add them to `.gitignore` yourself.
- **One preview server per machine, shared across dsh instances and other hosts.** The helper records where it listens in a single file under the user's home directory, and the first process to bind takes the default port, so a second process using the helper (another dsh instance, or the official editor extension) overwrites that record and serves on the next free port.
- **The preview needs dsh's built-in browser.** This bundle enables the `ui-sidebar-browser` row; disabling that row again leaves the trigger unable to open a tab. The tab opens automatically only while a Conversation is on screen — after returning to one, the next status poll opens it.

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · Develop：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build    # emits lib/index.js and lib/client.js (ModuleLoader handoff)

The client bundle resolves `react` from the dsh Web loader's platform module table and declares no other runtime dependency.

`pnpm run watch` rebuilds `lib/client.js` on change; the client HMR chain reloads the plugin in the browser without a page refresh.

@trujaycc/dsh-weixin-minigame README · References：The workflow this plugin guides the agent through, and the way it drives the MCP server, are modelled on the official [WeChat Mini Game Helper](https://gamemp.weixin.qq.com/doc/minigame-helper/guide/vscode-plugin.html).

The MCP service is `@weadmin/weixin-minigame-helper-mcp`. It is fetched with `npx` at runtime and is not redistributed with this package.
